prompts.day:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an actual Blood & Beans daytime gameplay screenshot. Image 2 is ONLY the vampire player's 3D model reference. Image 3 is ONLY the actual Unity object geometry reference. Image 4 is ONLY a restrained Luigi UI palette/font reference; never copy its environment or camera.
Create an additional PC gameplay UI mockup by editing Image 1. CRITICAL: faithfully retain Image 1's original camera, perspective, composition, framing/aspect ratio, original simple game environment, muted flat walls, diagonal wooden serving counter, flat checker floor, customer positions, existing appliances and white handleless cup stack. Do not extend, reframe, zoom, rotate, crop, rearrange furniture or beautify the scene. It must look like the same actual game screenshot with a UI reskin, not promotional art. No windows, ivy, chandeliers, atmospheric photography, depth of field or elaborate café scenery. Keep the simple realtime Unity game meshes and lighting.
Only replace the turquoise foreground player with the small 3D vampire from image 2, viewed FROM THE BACK in the identical silhouette footprint/camera scale of the original player, cropped at the bottom exactly like the source. Keep all four customers as the original simple 3D ghost models, preserving their hats and relative positions.
Remove the source debug dotted horizontal guide and debug label. Restyle the existing overhead order bubbles into compact dark matte forest green/cream rounded UI, a single thin edge, cream rounded Korean lettering. One price tag above each bubble: 22, 30, 114, 31 respectively; partially visible first customer remains cropped. Beverage images inside these bubbles should be tiny thumbnails of the plain handleless cups from image 3, not painted clipart; spent patience fills the INSIDE of each bubble from bottom to top, green/amber/red based on waiting. No separate patience bars.
Add slim PC HUD overlays within the top 8% of the screen: left a compact horizontal ranking strip '우리 1,240  B 1,180  C 980  D 720', centered compact clock '01:24' and 'DAY 3/7', right small revenue '340 / 120'. These overlays must stay SMALL and not dominate the 3D view. Add only small 'Q' skill hint at lower left and 'F1 조합법' at lower right. No bag anywhere in daytime.
The small making card belongs adjacent to the held cup on the lower right, matching the original card footprint or smaller: '카페모카', a small green check, three tiny actual-object ingredient thumbnails bean + milk bottle + chocolate. Use the real 3D cup/bottle/chocolate geometry of image 3, never handled mug or whipped cream.
Use restrained Luigi-inspired shapes and lively rounded thick headings with thin minimal dark outline. Dark green #233C35 and cream #E9DFCA, state green #8DBA8A. No fancy patterns, hardware, paper texture or permanent neon. Preserve the actual game scene and viewpoint above all else. Output a single complete gameplay screenshot, no labels outside the game, no board presentation.
prompts.correction: Precise small UI object correction only. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is the exact Unity object shape reference. Keep Image 1 camera, scene, player, all customer models, lighting, all panel positions, dimensions, labels and prices EXACTLY unchanged. Change ONLY beverage thumbnail models inside the four overhead bubbles and the lower-right making card. All cups must be the simple white cylindrical HANDLELESS cups from Image 2. The making card CafeMocha cup has flat coffee with dark rectangular chocolate chunks on top, matching CafeMocha row 1 column 5 in reference. No handle, no whipped cream, no swirled dollop, no saucer. Other bubble cups similarly handleless. Preserve every surrounding pixel and original aspect ratio. No other changes.
